decisions.text: behaviour: a date the read returns that is not yyyy-mm-dd leaves the strip's date empty, and the invoice number is cut to 40 characters (the simplest option) — reverse: show the raw printed date text and drop the 40-character cut in setInvoiceFrom_
behaviour: the percent shows only on rows with status update (not on same-price rows) — reverse: drop the status check on changePct in view_

behaviour: the invoices list uses the table layout of app-list-shell, so the shell's filter-toggle button shows although there are no filters — reverse: switch the list to layout=cards or hide the toggle in the shell
behaviour: a blocked pop-up or a failed file link closes the tab, logs the status and shows invoice_file_open_failed — reverse: drop the error toast in InvoicesListComponent.openFile

behaviour: case (h) asserts the invoice line row index as the position among the rows sent, [0,1], matching what the existing save test already expects. The answer's wording 'keep their row index' could be read differently — reverse: change the expected row values in that test.
